items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 8 at 5:23AM AKDT until May 9 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Annette Island.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 1 PM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued May 7 at 11:51PM AKDT until May 8 at 8:45PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is occurring.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim River near Aniak.

* WHEN...Until 9 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Water over roadways. River or stream flows are elevated.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7 PM AKDT, The River Watch Team reported an ice jam on
Kuskokwim River approximately 16 river miles downstream of
Aniak. The ice jam is causing river levels to rise upstream.

items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 7 at 7:44PM AKDT until May 8 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is possible.

* WHERE...Aniak and Kalskag

* WHEN...Through Friday evening.

* IMPACTS...Ice jams may result in flooding of rivers, creeks,
streams, sloughs, and other low-lying flood prone locations. Water
may impound behind a jam which may cause flooding several miles
upstream.

items.headline: Flood Warning issued May 7 at 5:38PM AKDT until May 10 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam continues.

* WHERE...Draanjik River near Chalkyitsik.

* WHEN...Until noon AKDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...There is a 10 mile long ice jam that starts several
bends below Chalkyitsik and looks like it will remain in place for
at least a few days. The upstream areas appear mostly ice free so
no further ice should accumulate on the jam. However, water levels
will likely continue to slowly rise until the jam releases.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued May 6 at 5:22PM AKDT until May 9 at 2:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

* WHERE...Chatanika River upstream of road access from Murphy Dome.

* WHEN...through Saturday.
